text: A separate agents-schedule microservice with its own database, image and chart.
Map a cron schedule to a preset (with a prompt), managed as schedules.
A schedule firing starts an agent session from its preset through the orchestrator API, exactly once, with missed runs collapsed, overlaps recorded, limits and a tracked outcome.
The schedules UI lives in the web UI (agents-web) hamburger menu.
Headless parity: a documented API and an API-only e2e for every capability.
Releases, pin bumps, the CNPG database and helmfile apply plus smoke are tasks of this epic.
The GitHub repo agents-schedule is created via workbench:component-add as an explicit, gate-listed task (epic agents-schedule-component); this epic builds on it.

Runs after agents-webhook-microservice and frontend-decoupling and consumes the shared parts they own (DB and queue helpers, orchestrator client, service-to-service auth, preset binding, UI kit and page pattern); builds none of them.
